text: - **THE PINNED TOOL OBJECT (canonical, hashed into the manifest).** `name`, `description`, `input_schema`, `capability_class`, `untrusted_input_facing`, `scope`, `privacy_sensitive`, `recoverability_basis` (null unless `owned_state`), `elevated`, and `containment_domain`. **Ten fields. This enumeration and the executable form (`canonicalFieldSet()`) MUST list the same set; if they diverge, the executable form is authoritative and this list is the bug.** `elevated` is pinned because the human-confirmation gate reads it: an allowlist held outside the manifest is authority the pinning system does not know exists (§8 #11). A gate must never decide on a property the manifest does not track — otherwise flipping that property escapes the gate without tripping pin drift.
